description: Agent Travel: submit the extras on a booking with what was authorized and needed: optionally the authorization with the most the extras may cost in all, its currency and the kinds approved (seat, bag, meal, wifi, lounge, priority, insurance, upgrade or other); what the fare includes, with its checked bags and whether seat selection comes with it; what the traveler needs, with the checked bags and whether a chosen seat is needed; and each extra with its id, kind, segment, description, quantity, amount, currency and whether the ticket or its documents show it. The signed report gives the authorization, what the fare includes, what is needed, every extra with whether its kind is authorized and whether it repeats another on the same segment, and the totals with the amount left under the cap, the checked bags bought and the total by kind, and counts them, and names excess extras: an extra of a kind the authorization leaves out, the same seat, meal or other single extra bought twice for one segment, a seat or bags bought where the fare includes them, an extra charged and missing from the ticket and extras over the authorized cap; then an extra not itemized with a kind and amount, bags or seats beyond what the traveler needs and extras in another currency, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No authorization, no cap, no authorized kinds, no record of which charged extras the ticket shows or no statement of need leaves the extras unverified. This reads the extras on one booking against what was authorized and needed: a paid call settled more than once is wever_double-charge-check, add-ons on a pricing page against its terms are wever_pricing-tier-check and a quote’s priced lines are wever_vendor-quote-check. Verdict travel_ancillary_excess, travel_ancillary_partial, travel_ancillary_unverified or travel_ancillary_as_authorized. POST /api/travel-ancillary-check. Reads the travel records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, booking or external write. Agent Travel reads a travel purchase an agent made, after the fact, from the traveler’s own records: the booking against the travel authorization, the itinerary against the trip as requested, the passenger details against the traveler’s ID, the fare rules against what the buyer was told, a change and a cancellation against the fare rules, the extras against what was authorized and needed, and a disruption against the carrier’s stated policy. Beside it, the Sports Trips tools such as wever_sports-trip-status plan, book and read a trip held on Wever, while a travel check reads a purchase made anywhere against its own records; wever_delegated-authority issues and reads the grant itself, while the authorization check reads one booking’s price, dates and class against the travel authorization behind it; and the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read a tokenized asset purchase, while a travel check reads a travel booking. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-travel-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-travel/.
